hero.headline: Building the Next Generation of AI Engineers
hero.supportingText: Empowering engineering students at Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering and Technology to pioneer transformative artificial intelligence through hands-on research, real-world deployment, competitive hackathons, and collaborative open-source engineering.

overview.about: The SIET AI Club & AI Lab at Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering and Technology is a vibrant epicenter for applied artificial intelligence, deep learning, computer vision, and cognitive systems. We bridge the gap between academic theory and high-impact industrial engineering by providing students with cutting-edge computing infrastructure, mentorship from seasoned researchers, and end-to-end product development pipelines.
scope: Deep Learning, Generative AI & Foundation Model Adaptation
Real-Time Computer Vision & Edge Intelligence on Embedded Silicon
Autonomous Systems, Robotics & Embedded IoT Sensor Fusion
Ethical AI, Algorithmic Fairness & Explainable Machine Learning
overview.aim: To nurture a thriving student-led ecosystem of creative problem-solvers who conceptualize, engineer, and deploy state-of-the-art AI systems that address genuine societal and industrial challenges.
goals: Incubate at least 15 production-grade student AI projects each academic year.
Provide accessible GPU workstation access to all passionate undergraduates.
Represent Sri Shakthi Institute at premier national and international AI hackathons.
Publish peer-reviewed student research in reputed conferences and journals.
Foster cross-disciplinary collaboration between Computer Science, Electronics, and Mechanical Engineering.

activities.title: Real-World Projects
activities.summary: Building end-to-end production AI applications solving real challenges on campus, healthcare, and smart cities.

activities.title: National Hackathons
activities.summary: Competing in premier national AI hackathons including Smart India Hackathon, SIET InnoVate, and Kaggle championships.

activities.title: Hands-On Workshops
activities.summary: Intensive masterclasses on PyTorch, Large Language Models, TensorRT optimization, and Vector Databases.

activities.title: AI & ML Contests
activities.summary: Monthly algorithmic challenges, model optimization sprints, and Kaggle-style internal leaderboard competitions.

activities.title: Industry Collaborations
activities.summary: Partnering with tech enterprises and AI startups for real-world capstone projects and research sponsorships.

activities.title: Peer Learning Circles
activities.summary: Weekly paper review reading groups, technical lightning talks, and open peer-to-peer code reviews.

featuredProjects.title: Smart Attendance System via Facial Recognition
featuredProjects.summary: An automated contactless attendance tracking pipeline powered by deep facial recognition models, anti-spoofing liveness detection, and instant faculty dashboard synchronization.

featuredProjects.title: SIET Campus AI Assistant & Chatbot
featuredProjects.summary: A multimodal Generative AI assistant featuring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over campus regulations, exam schedules, course materials, and administrative workflows.

featuredProjects.title: Multimodal Early Disease Prediction Platform
featuredProjects.summary: A clinical diagnostic decision support platform predicting cardiovascular and diabetic risks using ensemble gradient boosting, electronic health records, and explainable SHAP values.

featuredProjects.title: Edge AI Real-Time Object Detection Platform
featuredProjects.summary: Industrial safety and automated defect inspection deployed on NVIDIA Jetson embedded platforms with TensorRT optimization and sub-15ms inference latency.

featuredProjects.title: Neural Collaborative Course & Project Recommender
featuredProjects.summary: A graph neural network architecture suggesting personalized elective courses, research papers, and cross-departmental hackathon teammates based on skills and aspirations.

featuredProjects.title: Student Academic Performance & Dropout Predictor
featuredProjects.summary: An educational data mining system identifying at-risk academic indicators and recommending early personalized pedagogical interventions for mentors.

featuredAchievements.title: 1st Place — National Smart India Hackathon 2025
featuredAchievements.summary: Awarded ₹1,00,000 cash prize for the AI-Powered Agricultural Yield and Pest Advisory System under Ministry of Agriculture.

featuredAchievements.title: Best AI Paper Award — IEEE ICET 2026
featuredAchievements.summary: Presented novel edge-quantization techniques for Vision Transformers on constrained low-power robotics.

featuredAchievements.title: NVIDIA Academic Hardware Grant
featuredAchievements.summary: Awarded 4 NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPUs and 2 Jetson Orin Developer Kits to fuel student deep learning research in our AI Lab.

featuredAchievements.title: Top 10 Finalist — Global AI Agents Hackathon
featuredAchievements.summary: Recognized among top 10 from 1,200 international teams for autonomous multi-agent software testing framework.

upcomingEvents.title: Industry Tech Talk: Scaling AI at Enterprise Scale
upcomingEvents.summary: Guest lecture by Senior AI Architect from Microsoft Research on distributed training and inference clusters.
